verdicts.rationale: Commit 02c238690b introduced dynamic pricing in services/checkout/pricing.py via `dynamic_price(cart, customer)`, recomputing price at charge time. As noted in commit 8957606ede, quotes and charges disagree under load, causing POST /api/checkout/pay to fail with HTTP 422 validation errors.

Commit 8957606ede reverted 02c238690b in services/checkout/pricing.py at 11:35:59. If deployed around 12:00:00, removing dynamic pricing while active user sessions contained dynamic quotes may have triggered HTTP 422 errors due to price mismatch during checkout.
Commit 8d5e1ccf02 only modifies CI cache keys in .github/workflows/ci.yml and has no relationship to checkout service logic or 422 payment failures.
